description: The file defines an interface 'ThingSearchQueryCommand' in the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.thingsearch.query'. It specifies methods to set namespaces and retrieve an optional filter for searching things, and extends a generic 'ThingSearchCommand'.

classes.name: ThingSearchQueryCommand
classes.description: An interface that aggregates all 'ThingSearchCommand's which query the Search service, allowing setting namespaces and retrieving optional filter information.

methods.name: setNamespaces
methods.description: Sets the given namespaces on a copy of this command and returns it.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves the optional filter string for the search query.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is 'QUERY' by default.
